messages:
Eli (Product): Kickoff quick sync on the Private setup wizard connection diagnostics. Spotted some UX friction when customers have lots of hosts and on mobile. Screenshot + recording: https://redwood.design/s/setup-diagnostics
Rina (Design): Thanks. Main issues I saw: status chips in dark mode lose distinction (green/amber on dark gray). Also the inline logs are long and push actions off-screen on small widths.
Zoe (Engineering): For logs we could collapse them by default and show the last 3 lines plus a 'Show full log' control. That keeps the primary CTA visible. Example snippet CSS: ``` .log-preview { max-height: 84px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; } .log-preview.expanded { max-height: none; } ```
Luca (Accessibility): Relatedly: when logs expand, screen readers need to know content changed. Use aria-live="polite" on the log container and aria-controls from the toggle to the log region. Do not autofocus into it, just announce the change.
Arun (PM): Copy suggestion: avoid jargon in the summary row. Instead of 'Probe timeout (EC2)' try 'Connection timed out to instance (EC2) 12 Check security group and route tables.' Short action link: 'Fix connection' -> KB: https://redwood.design/kb/connectivity
Rina (Design): Visual change: add a subtle 1px outline for chips in dark mode and bump the text weight to 600 for better legibility. We'll test with token colors: success: #0ecb81, warn: #ffb86b, fail: #ff6b6b and ensure AA contrast.
Zoe (Engineering): Implementation note: probes can emit many quick state changes. We should debounce status updates client-side (250ms) to avoid too many announcements and flicker. Also add a small timeline icon that shows last probe time and lets users inspect event history.
Eli (Product): Good call. Also propose a compact host list view: avatar (host type), short status, truncated name, and an overflow kebab with actions. Tap/Enter expands details below. This helps on phones.
Luca (Accessibility): Keyboard pattern: rows must be in the tab order; Enter toggles expand. Use aria-expanded on the row button and ensure expanded region has aria-labelledby referencing the host row. Provide visible focus outline in high-contrast mode.
Arun (PM): Edge case: for air-gapped installs where we intentionally skip egress checks, show a subtle info pill 'Network checks skipped by policy' with a tooltip: 'Your admin disabled external probes for security reasons.' Let admins override per-deployment.
Rina (Design): Microcopy tweaks: make CTAs explicit: primary = 'Continue setup', secondary = 'Retry probe', tertiary = 'View logs'. Keep verbs first.
Zoe (Engineering): I'll add e2e hook to assert aria-live text contains "All probes complete" and that expanding a row sets aria-expanded=true.
deploy-bot: Reminder: UX walkthrough in 30min in #product-design. Bring mobile screens :mega:
Eli (Product): Acceptance criteria I'll add to the ticket: 1) compact host list on widths <= 480px, 2) log previews collapsed by default with accessible expand, 3) aria-live for probe status updates but debounce to avoid spam, 4) chip colors meet 4.5:1 contrast in both light and dark themes, 5) microcopy updated as above. Post Figma link and test build here when ready.
Rina (Design): I'll post two Figma variants: one with inline logs collapsed, one with a flyout for logs. Will include color tokens and tooltip strings.
Zoe (Engineering): Will target a small client patch for the accessibility announcer and the host-list mobile layout this sprint.
Luca (Accessibility): I'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass on the prototype and report back with any additional announcements or focus traps.
